pad_text_variable_length_embeddings: pad a list of variable-length text hidden states to a common length and return padded tensor with lengths
run_ernie_image_text_input_step: run the ErnieImageTextInputStep to pad text embeddings and produce text_bth and text_lens tensors for the denoiser
run_ernie_image_set_timesteps_step: run the ErnieImageSetTimestepsStep to set scheduler timesteps using a linear sigma schedule for inference
run_ernie_image_prepare_latents_step: run the ErnieImagePrepareLatentsStep to generate random noise latents for the denoising process
expand_text_embeddings_for_multiple_imag: expand text embeddings list by repeating each embedding num_images_per_prompt times
